svg.title: OpenAI standard rates for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
svg.desc: Per million tokens, OpenAI standard: Astra input $8, cached input $0.40, 30-minute cache write $10, output $40. Sol input $2, cached input $0.10, 30-minute cache write $2.50, output $10. Sol is one quarter of Astra on each of these four rates. Not a Vectoree price.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: OPENAI PUBLISHED CARD · PER MILLION TOKENS

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On every row, Sol is one quarter of Astra. Vectoree does not invoice this card.
